question.text: Fees paid to PMS of Rs. 4 lakh cannot be deducted against:

explanation.text: The Logic: PMS fees are NOT deductible against capital gains. The Trap: Other heads follow their own rules; PMS fees typically don't offset there either under current practice. Cross-Exam Context: Same in X-B, XIX-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Manage client expectations — they'll feel taxation more due to non-deductibility.
